# Candidate yogas and Kuja conventions (computed; named definitions, candidates only - not results)
Each line: definition id | holds? | details | source | how often the condition holds in random charts.
- [GK-BPHS36] Gajakesari, strict: Jupiter in a kendra from the lagna or the Moon, joined or aspected by a benefic, not debilitated, combust or in an enemy's sign: HOLDS. kendra from lagna yes, from Moon no; benefic contact Ve; debilitated no; enemy's sign no; combust no. Source: BPHS 36.3-4, source map BPHS_part3.md §5 (BPHS ch. 34-38), not page-checked. Base rate 9%.
- [KESARI-LOOSE] Kesari (loose 'Gajakesari'): Jupiter in a kendra from the Moon: does not hold. Jupiter M2. Source: Phaladeepika VI.14 per the BPHS translator (only 'Kesari'); called Gajakesari by CRUX p28-30 and HJH1 p118 - source map BPHS_part3.md, not page-checked. Base rate 34%.
- [KEM-BARE] Kemadruma (Varahamihira): no planet other than the Sun (nodes not counted) in the 2nd or 12th from the Moon: does not hold. 2nd/12th from the Moon: Ju. Source: Brihat Jataka XIII (p175-178), source map BJ.md, not page-checked; Varahamihira rejects the other schools' versions. Base rate 45%.
- [KEM-BPHS] Kemadruma (BPHS 37.11-13): besides the 2nd/12th, no planet but the Sun with the Moon or in a kendra from the lagna - the Moon itself in a kendra counts (LOL p322; Garga/Parasara via BJ): does not hold. 2nd/12th occupied. Source: BPHS p398 (ch. 37 sl. 11-13), source map BPHS_part3.md §5 (BPHS ch. 34-38), not page-checked. Base rate 3%.
- [PMP-Ma-BPHS] Ruchaka (Pancha Mahapurusha): Mars own/exalted in a kendra from the lagna: does not hold. Mars H9; BPHS gives no cancellation in this chapter. Source: BPHS ch. 75, source map BPHS_part6.md §5.1, not page-checked. Base rate 34%.
- [PMP-Ma-LOL] Ruchaka, LOL variant: kendra or kona from the lagna: HOLDS. Mars H9. Source: Phaladeepika VI.2-4 as given in LOL p311 (kendra or kona; BPHS ch. 75: kendra only), source map LOL.md, not page-checked. Base rate 48%.

- [PMP-Sa-LOL] Sasa, LOL variant: kendra or kona from the lagna: HOLDS. Saturn H9. Source: Phaladeepika VI.2-4 as given in LOL p311 (kendra or kona; BPHS ch. 75: kendra only), source map LOL.md, not page-checked. Base rate 48%.

Source: BPHS p356-358 (ch. 34 sl. 11-15), source map BPHS_part3.md §5 (BPHS ch. 34-38), not page-checked; PD XX.45 (p245) source map PD_part1.md, not page-checked. Base rate 68%.

Mars owns H7,12, in H9; DISPUTED - Mars also owns H12 (its moolatrikona: the evil lordship prevails): BPHS 34.14-15 gives no yoga by relation alone, PD XX.45 gives yoga even so. Source: BPHS p356-358 (ch. 34 sl. 11-15), source map BPHS_part3.md §5 (BPHS ch. 34-38), not page-checked; PD XX.45 (p245) source map PD_part1.md, not page-checked. Base rate 61%.

Mars from lagna 9, Moon 7, Venus 12; meets it from Moon, Venus; LOL exception: Mars own/exalted modifies or cancels it (experts disagree); the partner and age (about 28-30) exceptions need more than this chart. Source: LOL p329-331, source map LOL.md, not page-checked. Base rate 88%.
